label: setup
js: (() => { document.getElementById('hud').style.display = 'none'; window.__view = (px, py, pz, lx, ly, lz, mm) => { const r = __kk.rig; const P = r.cam.position.clone().set(px, py, pz), L = r.cam.position.clone().set(lx, ly, lz); r.presets[9] = { name: 'view', pos: () => P.clone(), look: () => L.clone(), mm, dof: 0, focus: () => 10 }; __kk.preset(9); }; __kk.rig.handheldAmount = 0; return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const k = __kk.kitten; const h = __kk.rig.cam.position.clone(); k.parts.head.getWorldPosition(h); const y = k.body.yaw; const f = { x: Math.sin(y), z: Math.cos(y) }; __view(h.x + f.x * 0.42, h.y + 0.004, h.z + f.z * 0.42, h.x, h.y - 0.004, h.z, 75); return h.toArray().map(v => v.toFixed(3)).join(','); })()

(() => { const k = __kk.kitten; const p = k.body.pos; const y = k.body.yaw; const f = { x: Math.sin(y), z: Math.cos(y) }, r = { x: Math.cos(y), z: -Math.sin(y) }; __view(p.x + f.x * 1.1 + r.x * 0.08, p.y + 0.2, p.z + f.z * 1.1 + r.z * 0.08, p.x, p.y + 0.19, p.z, 50); })()
